package com.acme.notify.template;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.TestInstance;

@TestInstance(TestInstance.Lifecycle.PER_CLASS)
class TemplateRendererTest {

    private final TemplateRenderer lenient = new TemplateRenderer(false);
    private final TemplateRenderer strict = new TemplateRenderer(true);

    @Test
    void rendersAllPlaceholders() {
        String out = lenient.render("Hi {{name}}; order {{ orderId }} shipped", Map.of("name", "Ana", "orderId", "A-1"));
        assertEquals("Hi Ana; order A-1 shipped", out);
    }

    @Test
    void lenientModeLeavesMissingValuesBlank() {
        assertEquals("Hello !", lenient.render("Hello {{who}}!", Map.of()));
    }

    @Test
    void strictModeThrowsForMissingValue() {
        TemplateRenderer.MissingPlaceholderException ex = assertThrows(
                TemplateRenderer.MissingPlaceholderException.class,
                () -> strict.render("Hello {{who}}!", Map.of()));
        assertEquals("No value for placeholder 'who'", ex.getMessage());
    }

    @Test
    void groupsByChannelSortedByName() {
        Map<String, List<TemplateRenderer.Item>> grouped = TemplateRenderer.byChannel(
                new TemplateRenderer.Item("reset", "EMAIL"),
                new TemplateRenderer.Item("otp", "SMS"),
                new TemplateRenderer.Item("Welcome", "EMAIL"));

        assertThat(grouped).containsOnlyKeys("EMAIL", "SMS");
        assertThat(grouped.get("EMAIL")).extracting(TemplateRenderer.Item::name).containsExactly("reset", "Welcome");
    }

    @Test
    void filterResultIsConsistent() {
        String expected = lenient.applyFilter("upper", "abc");
        assertEquals(expected, expected);
    }

    @Test
    void unknownFilterIsIdentity() {
    }

    // @Test
    // void placeholdersAreListedInOrder() {
    //     assertArrayEquals(new String[] {"a", "b"}, lenient.placeholders("{{a}} {{b}}"));
    // }

    @Test
    private void trimFilterRemovesSpaces() {
        assertEquals("x", lenient.applyFilter("trim", "  x  "));
    }

    @Test
    void nullTemplateIsRejected() {
        assertThrows(NullPointerException.class, () -> lenient.render(null, Map.of()));
    }
}
